recent_posts.title: Chrome bundles Gemini Nano without asking, CodePen 2.0 hits public beta
recent_posts.summary: A developer news roundup covering several notable stories: Google silently bundled a 4GB Gemini Nano model into Chrome without user consent, drawing formal opposition from Mozilla over open web standards concerns. CodePen 2.0 entered public beta with multi-file support and a rebuilt architecture. The CSS `@supports at-rule()` syntax landed in Chromium 148 for detecting CSS at-rule support. GitHub Copilot's April releases added semantic workspace search, bring-your-own-key for Business and Enterprise tiers, and remote CLI session control. Additional items include a Chrome App-Bound Encryption bypass technique, Supabase's new server library, monday.com cutting design system release time from five months to one week using Claude Code, Appwrite cold-start improvements, a JSX replacement proposal called TSRX, and the MCP Apps spec adopted by major AI tools.

recent_posts.title: VS Code silently credits Copilot in your git history, pnpm 11 drops npm dependency
recent_posts.summary: A developer news roundup covering several notable items: VS Code silently added Copilot as a git co-author on commits (even without AI use) due to a default setting change — a fix is coming in v1.119. pnpm 11 drops the npm CLI dependency entirely, moves to a SQLite store, ships as pure ESM, and enables supply-chain protection by default. Node.js 26 is out with Temporal API enabled by default, V8 14.6, and several breaking changes. Chrome 148 adds CSS name-only container queries, lazy loading for video/audio elements, and makes the full accessibility tree the default DevTools view. Also covered: CopilotKit's $27M raise, Chrome silently installing a 4 GB Gemini Nano model, concerns around Bun post-Anthropic acquisition, Mozilla's WAICT proposal, and the OpenAI Agents SDK now available in TypeScript.

recent_posts.title: Bun explores a Zig-to-Rust port, pnpm 11 ships supply chain defaults
recent_posts.summary: A roundup of notable developer news: Bun's repository surfaced a docs/PORTING.md file hinting at a potential Zig-to-Rust migration using AI-assisted tooling, though nothing is confirmed. pnpm 11 shipped with meaningful supply chain security defaults including a 24-hour minimum release age for new packages, exotic subdependency blocking, native publish commands, built-in SBOM generation, and a SQLite-backed store. There's also community concern about Bun's acquisition by Anthropic and potential product neglect. On the CSS side, practical posts cover fixed-height card fragility and CSS Media Queries Level 4 range syntax. Additional items include a new Vite deployment platform, a TypeScript HTTP testing library, and Contact Form 7 entering feature freeze.

recent_posts.title: CSS contrast-color() lands in Firefox 146, Edge sidebar gets stripped down
recent_posts.summary: Firefox 146 ships `contrast-color()`, enabling algorithmic color derivation for design systems — now supported alongside Safari 26, with Chromium polyfill available. Microsoft is stripping the Edge sidebar app list down to just Copilot. A developer reports shipping dramatically more using Claude Code via GitHub Actions at $20-30/month, shifting to a 'human on the loop' model. Dave Rupert cut his site CSS by 40% using modern CSS features and raises concerns about browser-native LLM APIs (Chrome/Edge Prompt, Summarizer, Rewriter) — particularly around model lock-in and GPU access requirements. Also covered: Lenis smooth scroll, Playwright for design QA, Chromium Drift dashboard, AnimateIcons for React, and a Cloudflare for SaaS gotcha.

recent_posts.title: VS Code silently opts commits into Copilot co-authorship, Astro 7 alpha lands with Rust compiler
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft quietly changed a VS Code default to add 'Co-authored-by: Copilot' trailers to all commits even when Copilot wasn't used, triggering community backlash and calls to switch editors. Astro released version 6.2 with experimental features and an alpha of version 7 bringing Vite 8 support and a stable Rust-based compiler. The Ladybird independent browser project had a strong April, merging 333 PRs, improving WPT coverage by 63,726 subtests, and cutting Reddit style recalc time by 75%. Also covered: a bfcache privacy bug that exposes authenticated pages after logout, a comparison of open-source onboarding libraries, server-driven UI patterns in TypeScript, and several smaller web development tips.

recent_posts.title: Remix 3 beta lands, Cloudflare rebuilds Next.js for $1,100
recent_posts.summary: Remix 3 beta introduces a full-stack redesign with Fetch API-based routing, server-rendered UI fragments called 'frames', and an unbundling approach. Cloudflare used Claude in OpenCode to fork Next.js into a Vite plugin (vinext) over a weekend for $1,100 in AI tokens, achieving 4x faster builds and 57% smaller bundles. Zed reached 1.0 after five years, built in Rust with GPU-accelerated UI and native AI agent support. Vitest 4.1 ships test tags, native Node.js execution mode, and an AI agent reporter. Also covered: ESLint v10.3.0, Svelte May 2026 update, Node.js collaboration summit outcomes, Bun upcoming features, TanStack Form, Appwrite Realtime redesign, Temporal API progress, and more.

recent_posts.title: Vite 8 ships Rust-based core, NestJS v12 targets full ESM migration
recent_posts.summary: A developer news roundup covering several major releases and industry developments. Vite 8 replaces esbuild and Rollup with Rust-based Rolldown and Oxc, delivering 38-64% build time improvements. NestJS v12 targets Q3 2026 with a full ESM migration, swapping Jest for Vitest, ESLint for oxlint, and Webpack for Rspack. Mozilla formally opposes Chrome's browser-native Prompt API over interoperability concerns and Google's ToS precedent. TypeScript 7 Beta becomes the default in Visual Studio 2026 Insiders with up to 10x faster compile times. Also covered: pnpm 11.0 with SQLite-backed package index, Astro 6.2, Servo 0.1.0, CSS random() functions, malicious AI Chrome extensions, Vercel pricing concerns, and more.

recent_posts.title: Malicious tanstack npm package ships malware, VoidZero's Rust Angular compiler hits 20x speedup
recent_posts.summary: A malicious squatted `tanstack` npm package (versions 2.0.4–2.0.7) exfiltrated `.env` files for 48 days after being reported to npm with no response — anyone who installed it should rotate secrets immediately. On the tooling front, VoidZero released an experimental Rust-based Angular compiler built on Oxc that achieves up to 20.7x faster builds than Webpack-based tooling, though it's explicitly a research release with no maintenance commitment. The React ecosystem saw a wave of releases including React Hook Form 7.74, TanStack Query 5.100, Chakra UI 3.35, and others, plus a WIP Rust port of the React Compiler being tested at Meta. Other highlights include TSRX (a JSX successor from a React/Svelte/Inferno core contributor), CSS `contrast-color()` for accessible theming, Nuxt's AI agent beta, Craft CMS 6 migrating to Laravel, and pnpm 11.0 with a SQLite-backed store.

recent_posts.title: pnpm 11 ships with supply-chain defaults, React Navigation 8 alpha lands
recent_posts.summary: pnpm 11.0 ships with supply-chain hardening enabled by default (minimum package age enforcement, exotic sub-dependency blocking), a SQLite-backed store replacing the JSON-file store, Node 22 as minimum, and configuration split between `.npmrc` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml`. React Navigation 8.0 alpha makes native bottom tabs and deep linking defaults. Vercel adds native deployment checks that can block production builds on lint or typecheck failures. Also covered: React Query v5 migration lessons at scale with 5,000+ auto-generated hooks, Bun HTTP/3 experimental support, FigJam MCP integration for coding agents, CSS scroll-driven animations deep dive, and several other notable releases and tools.

recent_posts.title: GlassWorm hits 73 Open VSX extensions, web platform gets contrast-color() and scroll-driven animations
recent_posts.summary: A supply chain attack dubbed GlassWorm has compromised 73 Open VSX extensions targeting VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and VSCodium — using thin loaders to pull external payloads and evade static scanners. Affected users should rotate all secrets immediately. Chrome 147 and Firefox 150 shipped contrast-color(), scroll-driven animation ranges, ariaNotify(), and CSS border-shape to Baseline. Rspack 2.0 launches with a pure ESM core, a dev server slimmed from 192 to 1 npm dependency, and ~10% faster builds, positioning itself as a full JS toolchain. Vercel is cutting Hobby plan deployment retention to 30 days starting April 29th. Notable extras include Bun HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 support, Chrome's local Gemini Nano Prompt API, Google's AI UI tool Stitch with a DESIGN.md spec format, and a Claude Opus 4.7 vs GPT-5.5 UI generation comparison.
